# OVHcloud AI Endpoints

Open models hosted in Europe.

| | |
|---|---|
| Kind | Chat API (OpenAI-compatible): returns code that conductor applies |
| Cost | Works without a key at 2 requests a minute per model; a key (Public Cloud project → AI Endpoints) allows 400. |
| Key | Optional (`OVH_AI_ENDPOINTS_ACCESS_TOKEN`, from https://www.ovh.com/manager/#/public-cloud/) — works without one |
| Endpoint | `https://oai.endpoints.kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net/v1` |
| Default model | picked automatically from the live list (coding models first); choose your own with `conductor models ovh --all` |
| conductor name | `ovh` |
| Provider docs | https://docs.ovhcloud.com/en/guides/public-cloud/ai-machine-learning/ai-endpoints-getting-started |
| Checked | 2026-11 |

## Set up

1. Add it to conductor. It asks for nothing, lets you pick a model, sends one test prompt and adds it to the `docs`, `test`, `review` and `ask` roles:
   ```bash
   conductor add ovh
   ```
2. Check it any time:
   ```bash
   conductor doctor --live
   ```

Or click **Add** on its card in `conductor ui` → Providers.

## Without the wizard

Then add this to `~/.config/conductor/config.json` (all projects) or `.conductor/config.json` (one project):
```json
{
  "providers": {
    "ovh": {
      "type": "openai",
      "enabled": true,
      "baseUrl": "https://oai.endpoints.kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net/v1",
      "apiKeyEnv": "OVH_AI_ENDPOINTS_ACCESS_TOKEN",
      "apiKeyOptional": true,
      "model": "<model id>"
    }
  }
}
```
List models: `conductor models ovh --all`. Put `ovh` in any role's chain in `conductor ui` → Roles & fallback.

The variable name only tells conductor where to find the key; the provider never sees it. To use a key you already keep under another name, set `"apiKeyEnv": "YOUR_VAR"` on `ovh`.

## Troubleshooting

- **401 / 403**: the key is wrong, expired, or still a placeholder. Run `conductor keys` to see where it comes from.
- **404 or "model not found"**: the model id changed. Pick a current one with `conductor models ovh --all`.
- **429**: rate limit. conductor puts the provider on cooldown and moves to the next one in the chain; `conductor cooldown --clear ovh` resets it.
- **Empty reply**: some free routes return nothing now and then; conductor retries once, then falls back.
